title: Calendar
summary: The calendar layout of the view set: month, week, day and list; records on the days of their date field, a move or a stretch is a change of the date fields the host settles. sf-view layout="calendar" draws it over the date window.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The rung of the bar, the day numbers, «+», «+N» and the list rows.

title-field.description: The record key an event's title reads (else title, name, id).

mode.description: The mode shown (else layouts.calendar mode, else month). On a phone week is three days and day is not offered.

date.description: A day of the period shown, yyyy-mm-dd (else today in the request's zone).

time-zone.description: The request's time zone (context.timeZone, C293): dates and times are shown and written in it; empty, the person's (the browser's).

week-start.description: The request's first day of the week (context.weekStart, C293), 0 or 7 Sunday to 6 Saturday; without it the page language's (ru Monday). Never stored in the view.

locale.description: The language of month and day names (Intl); empty, the page's.

now.description: «Now» for a page that shows one moment (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm): today and the now line; empty, the clock.

selectable.description: List mode rows carry the selection box; Space marks a row.

creatable.description: «+» in a day (on hover and focus, always on touch, C307 (4)): the create event with the date.

movable.description: Moves and stretches are offered; false refuses each with «Нет права менять».

truncated.description: The host gave the first 1000 records of the period only: «Показаны не все — сузьте фильтр».

undated-total.description: How many records have no date under the filter (the count on «Без даты N»); else the undated list's length.

undated-open.description: The «Без даты» column is open (kept by the view through the save event).

current.description: The record open in the record card (C305): its event is marked.

records.description: The records of the days on screen (the window {range}), up to 1000; each with id, revision, the date fields, can {update, reason} where the host limits it (CL-7).

undated.description: The records without a date (query window {undated}), for the «Без даты» column.

fields.description: Field descriptors (sf-view's columns): the date fields (a date field is all day, a datetime field timed; timeZone the source's zone, CL-5), the colour field's options (C140), the «Кратко» fields.

options.description: layouts.calendar of simai.view-config/1: date_field, end_field, all_day_field, mode, modes, color_field, event_fields (up to three), per_day (3), hours (["08:00", "20:00"]), slot (30), weekends show|hide, undated button|panel|none.

rules.description: The host's rules of the date field (describe().rules): [{code: past|weekdays|sunday..saturday|min|max|dates, reason, days?, date?, dates?}]; a refused day dims with the reason while an event is held. Other codes are the server's.

actions.description: The host's actions on a selection in the list mode, after «Перенести на…».

selected.description: The ids marked in the list mode.

window.const: {range: [from, to), date_field, end_field?} with context {timeZone, weekStart, locale}

update.const: record.set {record_id, key, value, patch, revision} -> applied {records} | refused {reason, message}

settleMove.summary: The host's answer to a move: {answer: applied, record?} keeps it; refused or conflict ({reason, message}) puts the event back and says why.

setMode.summary: Shows a mode (month, week, day, list).

goTo.summary: Shows the period around a day (yyyy-mm-dd).

returns.description: true when the day is valid

focusRecord.summary: Moves the focus to a record's event (the record card's close gives it back here).

returns.description: true when the event is on screen

sf-view-calendar-move.summary: An event moved or stretched (drag, touch, keys, the menu, «Перенести на…», from or to «Без даты»): patch holds the date fields in their own form; shown at once and pale until the host answers settleMove. Cancel to refuse at once.

sf-view-calendar-open.summary: An event pressed or «Открыть» (vocabulary open): the host opens the record card (sf-view-properties beside the list, C305).

sf-view-calendar-create.summary: «+» in a day: the host opens a new record with that date (and time).

sf-view-calendar-range.summary: The days on screen changed (period, mode, phone): the host answers the records of window.range [from, to).

sf-view-calendar-save.summary: The mode or the «Без даты» column changed: to keep in the view (layouts.calendar mode, the person's).

sf-view-calendar-apply.summary: A host action chosen on the selection in the bulk bar.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: the time zone of the source

untrusted_inputs: titles, option labels and field values (drawn as text or by the field renderers)

accessibility.focus: A region named by aria-label (else «Календарь»); the bar's controls, then one Tab stop for the grid with the W3C date grid keys inside; a polite live region says every move and refusal; after a settled move focus stays on the event.

changes: New: the calendar layout (owner decision C307): month, week, day and list modes over the host's date window in the request's time zone and week start; all-day and multi-day bars and timed events in their option's colour; «+N» opens the day list; moves and stretches by mouse, touch and keys as a change of the date fields the host settles (settleMove), refused days dim with the reason; «Без даты N» column; «+» on a day; the phone month with dots; selection in the list mode; one Tab stop with the W3C date grid keys.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-calendar through sf-view layout="calendar" for records with a date or a date and time (deliveries, tasks, bookings, meetings) that a person reads by day and moves between days.
do_not: Do not save a move in the element; answer sf-view-calendar-move and call settleMove.
Do not store a week start or a time zone in the view: they come from the request (C293).
Do not use it for a timeline (rows by people or resources).
